name: probbit stance
description: A personality and mood layer for the agent: a probbit individual (persona + seed) beside it: one engine event per user message in the sessions you list, its stance block injected into the turn, a replayable strand as the receipt; destructive tool calls a careful stance would deny are shadow-logged.

lanes.description: Session key (exact) or prefix ending in * → lane name. Only listed sessions get the hooks.

footerPrefix.description: Opens the footer line (default: the persona's name). An emoji or a short handle works.

glyphInReply.description: Default true: when the persona has display.glyphs, the block tells the model to use the engine's glyph as the reply's one mood emoji. The footer shows the glyph either way.

classifier.description: auto: host decision role when an agent decisionModel is configured, else keywords. jev: the Jev adapter (OpenRouter). keyword: keywords only.

classifierShadow.description: classifier jev only (default true): log Jev's answers, feed the engine the keyword flags.

jevKeyFile.description: Env-style file with OPENROUTER_API_KEY (default ~/.openclaw/probbit-stance/openrouter.env); read once at start.

sensesMode.description: Default off. shadow: measure tempo, tool_fail and the heuristic time_pressure each event and log them to strands/<lane>.senses.jsonl, feed nothing. feed: send the readings the persona declares.

timePressureSource.description: Default question: time_pressure only from the urgency question (live jev). heuristic: that answer, else the documented text heuristic (fed only with sensesMode feed). off: never.

agentName.description: The agent label of every lane's strand (default: the agent id of the session key).

labels.description: Labels written beside every lane's strand (strands/<lane>.labels.json) for probbit monitor. Keys 1-64 of [A-Za-z0-9_.-], values 1-64 characters; at most 4 keys besides agent, host, lane, session. A reserved key here overrides the value the plugin computes. Invalid entries are dropped with one warning.
